title: Sorceress in Cosmic Bubble
description: A lone sorceress in a flowing purple cloak stands on a rocky cliff, casting blue lightning from her hands. She is enclosed within a giant transparent bubble containing a surreal landscape with glowing blue waterfalls, a desert oasis, palm trees, and a massive red glowing portal in the sky revealing planets, a crescent moon, and ancient ruins.
prompt: A sorceress with long flowing purple hair and cloak stands on a rocky outcrop above glowing blue waterfalls, casting crackling blue lightning from her hands toward a giant red glowing circular portal in the sky. Inside the portal are planets, a crescent moon, and ancient desert ruins with palm trees. The entire scene is contained within a massive transparent spherical bubble with iridescent rainbow edges and purple nebulae, set against a black background.
